entries.autoLiqLevel: Account equity level below which auto-liquidation fires.
entries.expirationDate: Contract expiration date, yyyy-MM-dd. After this the contract no longer trades.
entries.totalUsedMargin: Current total used margin from MarginSnapshot (event-driven, throttled).
entries.netLiq: Net liquidation value — account equity mark-to-market. Tradovate formula: `cashBalance + openPnL + dollarCollateralCost`. Denominated in account base currency. Absent when any open position cannot be marked (no quote or no market data entitlement for its exchange).
entries.availableMargin: Margin headroom = `netLiq − totalUsedMargin`. Absent when any open position cannot be marked (no quote or no market data entitlement for its exchange).
entries.liqOnlyLevel: Account equity level at which the account enters liquidate-only mode (no new positions).
entries.netPrice: Volume-weighted average entry price of the net position (Tradovate `Position.netPrice`).
entries.tickSize: Minimum price increment, in contract-native price units.
entries.askPrice: Best offer (top-of-book). Note: the alert expression DSL uses `offerPrice` instead of `askPrice`.
entries.currentPrice: Mark price used for position P&L: bid (if long) / offer (if short), falling back to last trade, then settlement.
entries.trailingDrawdown: Trailing drawdown: max observed netLiq minus configured amount defines a floor; breach triggers auto-liq. Absent when any open position cannot be marked.
entries.dayPnL: Total session P&L = `realizedPnL + openPnL`. Resets at session boundary. Absent when any open position cannot be marked (no quote or no market data entitlement for its exchange).
entries.netPos: Signed net position quantity (Tradovate `Position.netPos`). Positive = long, negative = short, zero = flat. No separate Side enum.
entries.initialMargin: Initial margin required to open or hold the position (per contract).
entries.tickValue: Monetary value of one tick, in contract currency.
entries.openPnL: Unrealized P&L across all open positions. Each position is marked at the bid (if long) / offer (if short), falling back to last trade, then settlement. Absent when any open position cannot be marked (no quote or no market data entitlement for its exchange).
entries.trailingPeg: Trailing-stop peg state: `armed=true` after the first quote captures the peg distance; `distance` is the trail distance in price units.
entries.realizedPnL: Realized (closed-trade) P&L for the current trading session; sum of per-cashBalance realized-PnL columns.
entries.cashBalance: Sum of per-currency cash balances on the account (ledger), before open-P&L adjustment.
entries.brackets: Bracket legs (TP/SL) spawned by an entry order on fill. Prices are signed deltas from the entry's working price, in contract-native units.
entries.valuePerPoint: Monetary value of a 1-point move (tickValue / tickSize).

description: Field-name → meaning index. Semantics shared across tools. Use describe(topic='fields') to get the full index.
